utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone. The Chamber is sitting pursuant to 15 bis, Judge Robinson [sic] being away due to his urgent personal reasons. Mr. Tieger and Mr. Robinson, the Chamber has been informed that Mr. Karadzic is ill. Do you have any further information, Mr. Robinson?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So unless there's a matter to be dealt with, the hearing is adjourned until tomorrow. Yes, Mr. Tieger.

utterances.speaker: MR. TIEGER
utterances.text: Just to note, Mr. President, that we're operating on the basis that this is a day-to-day matter with some necessary optimism and trying to adjust the -- consider adjustments to the schedule accordingly. Should any Trial Chamber intervention be of assistance, we -- we will let the Court know.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. The hearing is adjourned until tomorrow, and if there's any further developments, the parties will be informed accordingly. We'll rise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 6th day of December, 2011, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 9.16 a.m.,
